# Contributing to SpeechNexa

SpeechNexa is a personal, owner-maintained AGPL-3.0-only project. Issues and pull requests can be opened in [this repository](https://github.com/Gaurav598/SpeechNexa-AI-Voice-Studio/issues); acceptance is at the owner's discretion. The inherited upstream project's CLA, signing issue, Discord and release process do not govern SpeechNexa.

For source setup and the verified speech path, see the [README](../README.md). Before proposing a change, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md), and the [implementation status](../docs/IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md). Keep Electron and FastAPI tests relevant to the change green, use offline model fixtures in CI, and do not commit weights, recordings, caches or secrets.

SpeechNexa retains inherited copyright and third-party notices. See [UPSTREAM.md](../UPSTREAM.md), [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), and [model licensing](../docs/MODEL_LICENSING.md). A contribution does not transfer ownership of inherited components or their separate model rights.
